text: The not-for-profit foundation Robert Bosch Stiftung GmbH holds roughly 94 percent of the share capital of Robert Bosch GmbH; about 93 percent of voting rights are held by Robert Bosch Industrietreuhand KG.
short: Bosch is 94% owned by the charitable Robert Bosch Stiftung.
